svg.title: Selected core Guteneo entity relationships
svg.desc: Organizations scope membership, document and dispatch records. Each dispatch can reference zero or one document and has at most one current approval, reservation and outbox row. The schema allows multiple attempt records; this does not authorize automatic retry. Selected relationships and columns only, not the complete schema.
